name: Democratic Republic of the Congo

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024. Land area 2,267,050 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2, mid); high is surface area incl. inland water 2,345,410 km2 (AG.SRF.TOTL.K2).

population.note: asOf 2025 (World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 112,832,473). Low allows for census uncertainty; high adds one year of growth to 2026 (~3.2%/yr).

activePersonnel.note: IISS Military Balance 2025 p.467 as quoted: 128,350 active FARDC. CIA Factbook 2025 100-150,000; World Bank 134,000 (2020). Real effective strength is lower (ghost soldiers).

trainedReserves.note: Educated guess. No organised reserve; Wazalendo militias (tens of thousands) fight alongside the FARDC but are not trained reserves.

supportPersonnel.note: Active 128,350 minus infantry P roles (15,000 + 80,000) = 33,350: air force, navy, crews, logistics, administration.

mobilizationRatio.note: Regional analogy: weak state capacity; mobilization goes through militias rather than the army. Educated judgement.

count.note: Educated guess. Republican Guard and the few motorised/armoured brigades. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Armed_Forces_of_the_Democratic_Republic_of_the_Congo)
Educated guess. FARDC infantry brigades/regiments in the east (Kivus, Ituri) and garrisons. Many units understrength; ghost soldiers.

Land Forces list: T-55 32 + Type 59 12-17 + T-64BV1 25 + T-72AV 100 = ~172 MBT, plus PT-76 10 and Type 62 30 light tanks = 212 (high). Mid ~150, low for serviceability. MBT list (IISS-derived, older) gives only 20 T-55.
BMP-1 20 + BTR-50 3 + MT-LB 6 + BTR-60PB 30-70 + Mbombe 4 20 + Panhard M3 58 + Calidus MCAV-20 30 = ~187 (mid, BTR-60 at 50). Armoured cars (AML, Cascavel ~50) excluded.
M-30 77 + Type 59 42 + D-20 6 + 2S1 6 + 2S3 10 + Type 63 12 + BM-21 24 + RM-51 6 + Type 82 3 + Katyusha 12 = 198 (mortars excluded).

Educated guess. Su-25 (ex-Georgian, ~2-4 airworthy) are not in the current inventory table; AHRLAC Mwari 6 on order. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Air_Force_of_the_Democratic_Republic_of_the_Congo)
SA330 10 + Gazelle 3 + Alouette III 2 + UH-1H 3 + Bell 206 2 + Mi-2 2 + Mi-8/17 6 + Mi-35 9 + Mi-26 1 + IAR 330 1 = 39 (high); mid for serviceability.

training.note: Rubric 0.25: many flown by foreign contractors.

count.note: Educated guess. CH-4B UCAVs from China (delivered 2023, several lost) and reported TB2/Turkish drones; counts unpublished. (context page: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/factbook/factbook.json/master/africa/cg.json)

Educated guess. National Navy has a handful of patrol boats on Lake Tanganyika, Lake Kivu and the Congo River; Atlantic coastline 37 km. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Armed_Forces_of_the_Democratic_Republic_of_the_Congo)
ZPU-4 12 + M-1939 37 mm 52 guns at ~6 per battery ~10 (high); MANPADS excluded. Mid for serviceability.

commandQuality.note: Rubric 0.25 minus: repeated collapses (Goma 2012 and 2025), corruption, reliance on foreign contractors and allies (Burundi, SADC until 2025).

cohesion.note: Rubric 0.25 minus: integrated ex-rebel factions, unpaid units, desertion and abuses.

morale.note: Rubric 0.25: unpaid troops, occupied eastern provinces.

weapons.note: Anchor 8 minus: WWII-to-1970s Soviet/Chinese artillery and small arms.

fortification.note: Anchor 7-8: field positions; negligible air defence.

logistics.note: Anchor 7-8: few roads; river and air transport dominate.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 148,179,869,391 2011 int$ / population 112,832,473 = 1,313. Range +/-20%. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 185,109,143,525 x 0.8005 = 148,179,869,391 2011 int$. Range +/-20%. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank: 1.38% of GDP in 2025. Much security spending is off-budget or channelled through the presidency (high is an allowance).

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction (and mining/oil where present) 39.7% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). +/-2 points.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. Chronic food insecurity (over 20 million people acutely food insecure) despite vast arable land; subsistence farming.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 55,984,510 (SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN) x share aged 15-19 10.533% / 5 = 1,179,338. Males only (conscript-pool convention). Range +/-10%.

roadKm.note: Road list (2015): 152,373 km total (high, mostly unusable in rainy season), 3,047 km paved (mid). World Bank IS.ROD.TOTL.KM 153,497 km (2004).

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 3,641 route-km (World Bank IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). CIA Factbook 4,007 km (2014) spans the range. Disconnected networks (Katanga, Matadi-Kinshasa), largely dilapidated.

majorPorts.note: CIA Factbook 2024: 3 ports (Matadi, Boma small; Banana very small).

merchantTonnage.note: Educated guess. CIA Factbook: 24 ships under the DRC flag (2023). (context page: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/factbook/factbook.json/master/africa/cg.json)

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. Road network almost non-existent in the east; sustainment by air and river.

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Few draft animals (tsetse zone); porters used instead.

nuclearWarheads.note: Non-nuclear-weapon state (NPT); not listed by FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.1: vast, forested terrain hard for any invader; little population support for the FARDC in the east.

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data, 2026 order of battle. War in the east: the Rwanda-backed M23/AFC took Goma (January 2025) and Bukavu (February 2025); US- and Qatar-brokered peace frameworks were signed in 2025 but fighting continued. ADF (ISIS-DRC), CODECO and 100+ other armed groups are active. FARDC strength figures are inflated by ghost soldiers; counts from the Wikipedia Land Forces equipment list and Air Force inventory (grade C) with educated guesses where nothing is published. Population convention: everything inside ne:COD including M23-held territory. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011 (+/-20%). Wazalendo militias, Burundian troops and foreign contractors excluded. Doctrine archetype-insurgent: the war is fought largely by irregulars on both sides.
